examples.english: He says he hates being late, but he is always late—that's pure irony.

examples.english: He said, “You're really punctual,” but it was sarcasm because I was half an hour late.
examples.traditional: 佢話「你真係好準時喎」，其實係講反話，因為我遲到咗半個鐘。
